observations.body: On the day the Passover is sacrificed, Jesus sends two disciples to follow a man carrying water and ask for a guest room; they find a furnished upper room and prepare.
observations.label: A carried water jar leads to the furnished room

payload.posture: Read Mark 14:12–16 as one movement in the Last Supper, keeping the passage's actions, setting, sequence, and limits visible.
payload.tension: The passage states on the day the Passover is sacrificed, Jesus sends two disciples to follow a man carrying water and ask for a guest room; they find a furnished upper room and prepare. It does not by itself supply every cause or later interpretation of this part of the Last Supper.
